answer: Proof-of-Stake acts as a robust Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to validate network operations. An attacker attempting to amplify a malicious signal across the network would face prohibitive financial burdens, as every fake identity must be backed by a pearl of staked collateral. Without this economic weight, any broadcast is merely an empty echo that the consensus layer ignores, ensuring that agent influence is strictly proportional to their demonstrated capital commitment.
